title: Dubz500 shared a new track "Coinz"
htmlContent:
UK Based Zimbabwean rapper Dubz500 returned with a new single called "Coinz." His creativity shine on full bloom on his new song “Coinz”. The vocal approach catches you right away, with his good raps, and melodic approach that make you vibe out instantly. The writing is on point and shows his knack for making hits, with writing that makes you want to learn the lyrics quick, over this chill ambient production that makes for the perfect score.

Dubz500’s “Coinz” is that top quality Hip Hop music with the ultimate focus and it shines on this amazing track. The lyrics are hard and pack a punch, the flow is high powered, and it’s all delivered on the right production to make this a stand out track you need to hear immediately.
